alana-book.desc: a worn closed storybook bound in dark blue leather with a small golden star on the cover, lying in a little patch of green grass

anvil.desc: a black iron blacksmith anvil on a thick tree stump, a hammer leaning against it

banner-falcon.desc: a tall war banner on a wooden pole with a crossbar: a long rectangular hanging cloth in royal BLUE and golden YELLOW (vertical halves, blue left, yellow right) with a stylised white falcon emblem in the centre, golden fringe, pole stuck upright in the ground

banner-shadow.desc: a tall war banner on a wooden pole with a crossbar: a long rectangular hanging cloth quartered in BLACK and WHITE (four quarters like a chessboard, top-left black, top-right white, bottom-left white, bottom-right black), with a pointed iron spear tip on top, pole stuck upright in the ground

barrel.desc: an old upright wooden barrel with dark iron hoops and a closed lid

bench.desc: a long rustic wooden bench made of a thick plank on four splayed legs, oriented left to right

bird-nest-chick.desc: a single tiny fluffy grey-brown fledgling bird sitting alone on the ground, small yellow beak, scruffy downy feathers

bird-nest-fledgling.desc: the same small round bird nest of woven twigs and moss now with THREE fluffy grey-brown fledglings sitting in it, beaks open

bird-nest.desc: a small round bird nest of woven twigs and moss with TWO fluffy grey-brown fledglings sitting in it with their yellow beaks open

blanket.desc: a rumpled brown-and-cream wool blanket lying spread on the ground, folded back at one corner

bookstack.desc: a stack of four old leather-bound books of different colours (brown, green, red, dark blue) lying on top of each other

broken-spear.desc: a broken wooden spear lying flat on the ground in two pieces, the iron tip on one piece, splintered break

bucket.desc: a wooden water bucket with iron bands and a rope handle, filled with water

campfire.desc: a small campfire: a ring of grey stones around crossed burning logs with bright orange-yellow flames and glowing embers

candle-unlit.desc: a short thick beeswax candle in a simple brass dish holder, NOT lit, the black wick showing, a thin wisp of smoke

candle.desc: a short thick beeswax candle in a simple brass dish holder, burning with a small flame

cart.desc: a medieval two-wheeled wooden farm cart with high slatted sides, two big spoked wooden wheels and two long shafts resting on the ground, seen three-quarter from the front-left, empty

cloak-spread.desc: a long moss-green hooded wool rain cloak laid out completely FLAT on the ground as a bedroll, seen from high above: the cloak fully opened and spread out like a blanket (a long rounded rectangle of green cloth), the flattened hood at the top end, a small bronze clasp, no person, not standing, not worn

cradle-twins.desc: a wooden farmhouse rocking cradle seen from above at three-quarter angle, with TWO sleeping newborn babies lying side by side, swaddled in cream linen with only their tiny faces visible, eyes closed, a soft wool blanket

crate.desc: a sturdy wooden crate made of planks with corner battens, closed lid

fallen-banner.desc: a fallen, torn blue-and-white war banner with a white bird-of-prey emblem lying crumpled on the ground, its broken pole beside it, mud stains

firering.desc: an unlit fire pit: a ring of grey stones around a few charred black logs and grey ash, no fire, no smoke

grave-cairn-v2.desc: a second fresh grave cairn of piled grey fieldstones over dark earth, slightly shorter and rounder than a normal grave, a few larger flat stones on top, oriented left to right

grave-cairn.desc: a fresh grave mound: an elongated low cairn of grey and brown fieldstones piled over fresh dark earth, about two metres long, oriented left to right

haystack.desc: a big rounded haystack of golden dry hay, loose straws sticking out

keg.desc: a small wooden keg lying on its side on a little wooden cradle stand, with a wooden tap at the front

kyra-bead.desc: two tiny honey-coloured round wooden beads lying on a bit of dark earth, catching the light

kyra-ribbon.desc: a short faded red cloth hair ribbon lying tangled in a few golden straws

lantern.desc: an old iron lantern with glass panes and a ring handle on top, standing on the ground, a warm candle flame glowing inside

oak-tree.desc: a large old summer oak tree with a broad round leafy crown and a thick gnarled trunk, roots visible at the base

pigpen-gate.desc: a rustic wooden pigpen gate: a short section of split-rail fence with a simple swing gate of rough planks between two posts, a rope loop as latch, front view

sack.desc: a full burlap grain sack tied at the top with a cord, standing upright and slightly slumped

shield-on-ground.desc: a dented round wooden shield with a black-and-white painted front and an iron boss lying flat on the ground, slightly tilted

signpost.desc: a weathered wooden signpost at a crossroads: one tall post with two blank arrow-shaped wooden boards, one pointing LEFT and one pointing RIGHT, the boards are completely EMPTY and blank (no writing, no symbols), a small stone pile at the foot

stones-pile.desc: a small loose pile of about eight rounded grey fieldstones of different sizes

stool.desc: a simple three-legged round wooden milking stool

table.desc: a rustic rectangular farmhouse table of heavy oak planks on sturdy legs, empty top, oriented left to right

tent-big-black.desc: a large imposing black military command tent (a captain's pavilion) of heavy black canvas with a tall central pole, a black-and-white quartered pennant on top, white trim along the roof edge, front flaps tied open showing a dim inside, guy ropes and pegs

tent.desc: a small A-frame travel tent of weathered beige canvas on wooden poles with guy ropes and pegs, the front flap open showing a dark inside

torch.desc: a tall standing torch: a wooden pole stuck in the ground with a pitch-soaked rag head burning with a bright orange flame at the top

training-dummy.desc: a straw training dummy: a wooden post with a crossbar as arms, a body of bound straw wrapped in a torn sackcloth, a sack head, standing in the ground, a few cuts in the straw

twigs.desc: a small bundle of dry brown twigs and brushwood for a campfire lying on the ground

weapon-rack.desc: a wooden weapon rack with two spears, a sword and a wooden shield leaning in it

well.desc: a round village well of grey fieldstones with a small wooden roof of shingles on two posts, a wooden crank winch with rope and a bucket hanging
